753:t_115:3.en:
$$聖アドヴェント$$
「The sight of lesser beings coming at me with their hearts united is both endearing and pitiful.」

753:t_115:4.en:
$$ロゼ$$
「You look down on everything and think you're absolute! Your ego is just like $$ズール$$'s!」

753:t_115:5.en:
$$聖アドヴェント$$
「It displeases me to be placed on the same level as such a being.」

753:t_115:6.en:
$$ロゼ$$
「Then I'll correct myself! You're even more self-righteous than $$ズール$$!」

753:t_115:7.en:
$$ロゼ$$
「I won't let someone like you do as he pleases with the universe! I won't give our future to someone who doesn't know what love means!!」

753:t_115:8.en:
$$ケンジ$$
「$$コスモクラッシャー$$, charge! Let's do it, everyone!」

753:t_116:0.en:
$$聖アドヴェント$$
「$$シモン$$... Now, for the first time, you will know a true limit.」

753:t_116:2.en:
$$ヴィラル$$
「It's no use, $$アドヴェント#pilot$$. Saying that to $$シモン$$ only has the opposite effect.」

753:t_116:3.en:
$$シモン$$
「I've hit limits plenty of times before! And every time, my drill has smashed right through them!」

753:t_116:4.en:
$$聖アドヴェント$$
「I told you, didn't I? What I shall show you is a true limit.」

753:t_116:5.en:
$$聖アドヴェント$$
「It is something you cannot overcome, however you struggle or stake your life... That something is me.」

753:t_116:6.en:
$$シモン$$
「Enough bullshit! From here on, it's one man's grit and fighting spirit against another's!」

753:t_116:7.en:
$$シモン$$
「Here I come, $$アドヴェント#pilot$$! I'll cross your so-called limit and keep going!」

753:t_116:8.en:
$$シモン$$
「I'll break through the heavens and dimensions! That's how I... how humanity liiiives!!」

753:t_117:0.en:
$$聖アドヴェント$$
「You would live as a teacher to children on a remote island, far from the glamorous world...」

753:t_117:1.en:
$$聖アドヴェント$$
「That was the life that suited you. Yet here you are, pointing your gun at me at the end of myth.」

753:t_117:2.en:
$$ヨーコ$$
「That's the life I want too.」

753:t_117:3.en:
$$ヨーコ$$
「But if someone tries to snuff out those children's future, Miss $$ヨマコ$$ will fight him with everything she's got!」

753:t_117:4.en:
$$ヨーコ$$
「Get ready, $$アドヴェント#pilot$$! I'll beat you, save the universe and go back to those kids!!」

753:t_117:5.en:
$$ヨーコ$$
($$キタン$$...! Lend us your strength!)

753:t_118:0.en:
$$聖アドヴェント$$
「Boy, you mistake recklessness for courage.」

753:t_118:1.en:
$$ギミー$$
「Doing the impossible is $$大グレン団$$ tradition! So is winning with that momentum!」

753:t_118:2.en:
$$聖アドヴェント$$
「Tradition? Using that word before one who has lived 120 million years is nothing short of ridiculous.」

753:t_118:3.en:
$$ギミー$$
「Shut up! We'll overcome you and create the next 120 million years ourselves!」

753:t_118:4.en:
$$ギミー$$
「To take that first step, there's no way we'll lose to you!!」

753:t_119:0.en:
$$聖アドヴェント$$
「Girl, you fight while trembling with fear.」

753:t_119:1.en:
$$ダリー$$
「So what?! I'm part of $$大グレン団$$ too!」

753:t_119:2.en:
$$聖アドヴェント$$
「I could free you from your fear and give you peaceful sleep.」

753:t_119:3.en:
$$ダリー$$
「I'll overcome my fear myself! That's how $$ギミー$$ and I have lived!」

753:t_119:4.en:
$$ダリー$$
「So I won't lose! I'll shake off your words!」

753:t_120:0.en:
$$聖アドヴェント$$
「$$ノリコ$$, $$カズミ$$... Let me commend your efforts in saving a certain world 12,000 years ago.」

753:t_120:2.en:
$$ノリコ$$
「Because now we're going to save the universe from a crisis that comes once in 120 million years!」

753:t_120:3.en:
$$聖アドヴェント$$
「That is a fate that can no longer be stopped. You should accept that fact quietly.」

753:t_120:4.en:
$$ノリコ$$
「I won't obey a fate someone else decided for me!」

753:t_120:5.en:
$$カズミ$$
「The power to overcome it... That is the flame burning within $$ガンバスター$$!」

753:t_120:6.en:
$$聖アドヴェント$$
「You are fools. I allowed you to die in peace, yet you choose pain.」

753:t_120:7.en:
$$ノリコ$$
「No matter how hard or painful it gets, we won't give up until the very last moment!」

753:t_120:8.en:
$$カズミ$$
「We won't wait for a miracle. We'll make one with our own hands...!」

753:t_120:9.en:
$$ノリコ$$
「By defeating you, our final enemy!」

753:t_120:10.en:
$$ノリコ$$
「That's the love, hard work and guts $$コーチ$$ taught us!!」

753:t_121:0.en:
$$ラルク$$
「I thought you were shady, but I never expected you to start calling yourself God!」

753:t_121:1.en:
$$聖アドヴェント$$
「I was not born a god. I merely chose to call myself God with my own resolve and responsibility.」

753:t_121:2.en:
$$聖アドヴェント$$
「Let us rejoice together, $$ラルク$$, that you witnessed the birth of God alongside a new world.」

753:t_121:3.en:
$$ラルク$$
「No thanks! I want no part of a world built on our world's destruction, or a god who forces himself on us!」

753:t_121:4.en:
$$ラルク$$
「I don't care whether you're a god or a devil! But if you take what's precious to us, you'll answer to me!」

753:t_121:5.en:
$$ラルク$$
「Even if I'm no longer $$トップレス$$, I still have my fighting spirit... my hard work and guts! That gives me the power to protect the world!!」

753:t_122:0.en:
$$チコ$$
「The god I wished to as a kid wasn't someone like you.」

753:t_122:1.en:
$$聖アドヴェント$$
「Don't confuse a product of your imagination with me, a real being, $$チコ$$.」

753:t_122:2.en:
$$聖アドヴェント$$
「But if you wish it, I will do my best to grant it.」

753:t_122:3.en:
$$チコ$$
「Then save this universe, and while you're at it, make just yourself disappear!」

753:t_122:4.en:
$$聖アドヴェント$$
「I cannot. My existence is the universe itself.」

753:t_122:5.en:
$$チコ$$
「Then stop calling yourself God like you're so great! I'll do it myself!」

753:t_122:6.en:
$$チコ$$
「I'll beat you and save this universe! I fight to make people's wishes come true!!」

753:t_123:0.en:
$$聖アドヴェント$$
「Let me save you from your suffering, $$ニコラ$$.」

753:t_123:2.en:
$$聖アドヴェント$$
「You could become a $$真徒$$ in the new world. Then I would grant you eternity too.」

753:t_123:3.en:
$$ニコラ$$
「An attractive invitation. I'll take you up on it...」

753:t_123:4.en:
$$ニコラ$$
「That's how I would have answered a little while ago.」

753:t_123:5.en:
$$聖アドヴェント$$
「Will your bravado cost you your last chance?」

753:t_123:6.en:
$$ニコラ$$
「Sorry, but I have my pride too! I'm not so childish that I can stay in shorts forever!」

753:t_123:7.en:
$$ニコラ$$
「That's how it is, self-proclaimed God! I'll bury you along with my boyhood!!」

753:t_124:0.en:
$$聖アドヴェント$$
「$$葵$$, $$くらら$$, $$朔哉$$, $$ジョニー$$, $$エイーダ$$... The time has come for the beast to sleep too.」

753:t_124:1.en:
$$葵$$
「You're acting like quite the big shot just because you absorbed the other $$御使い$$s, $$アドヴェント#pilot$$.」

753:t_124:2.en:
$$くらら$$
「You've even started having delusions of grandeur and calling yourself God.」

753:t_124:3.en:
$$聖アドヴェント$$
「There is no need to put on a brave face. You should be able to sense my power by instinct.」

753:t_124:4.en:
$$朔哉$$
「So what the hell does that matter?」

753:t_124:5.en:
$$ジョニー$$
「Do you think that's enough to make us flinch?」

753:t_124:6.en:
$$エイーダ$$
「Too bad. We've made it this far by beating every enemy like that.」

753:t_124:7.en:
$$聖アドヴェント$$
「That was until now. I am mightier than any opponent you have fought before.」

753:t_124:8.en:
$$葵$$
「But we'll surpass you! That's how we... how $$チームＤ$$ lives!」

753:t_124:9.en:
$$葵$$
「Is everyone ready?! This is our greatest, last battle! We'll burn through everything we've got!」

753:t_124:11.en:
$$朔哉$$
「I'm ready whenever! Let's do it!」

753:t_124:12.en:
$$ジョニー$$
「I'll stake everything too! Let's do it!」

753:t_124:13.en:
$$エイーダ$$
「We are one! Let's do it!」

753:t_124:14.en:
$$葵$$
「We'll end this, $$アドヴェント#pilot$$! This is the blood of the beast... our fighting spirit!」

753:t_125:0.en:
$$聖アドヴェント$$
「$$赤木$$... For a mere office worker, you have fought well to make it this far.」
